description:
Csat Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving target creature +3/+0 and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
If you control at least eight Stormsplitters, activate Thermopod's second ability four times by sacrificing four Stormsplitter tokens, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
